key: Kick Off 2 (1990)(Anco)[cr Oracle][tr Tu].adf boot-block load +$1600 to $030000 (140288 bytes):0:C302
name: blit_table_tiles_wrapping_column
description: Copies a source word looked up from a table into the destination in fifteen passes of forty-eight blitter rows each, after waiting for the blitter to go idle and setting the modulo and control registers for a plain copy. The destination advances by 2016 bytes per pass and wraps back by 28224 bytes when it passes a set limit.
